offer.heading: Get the same report for your own help center
offer.body: Send me at least 15 questions your customers really ask (30 or more is better; ticket subject lines are fine), and the link to your help center. I'll run this test on your own docs and show you what the bot gets right, what it gets wrong, and what fixing it would take. It's {audit_price} as an Upwork project, and the fee counts toward a build if you go ahead within 30 days.
offer.data: I use your docs and questions only for this audit, never share them, and delete them after delivery unless you go ahead with the build.
